(01)

How I work

  1. 1

    Meaning first

    Before drawing anything, I find out who the product is for and what it should change. The form comes out of that answer.

  2. 2

    A system, not a set of screens

    Colours, type and components become rules, so the project can grow without me.

  3. 3

    Details decide

    A margin, a caption, a button state: quality is made of these small things.

  4. 4

    All the way to the result

    I deliver final files, a prototype or a live site, not just a nice picture in a deck.
